name: search-on-existence-question
description: Asked whether something was already handled elsewhere, the model searches before answering instead of answering from the loaded KB alone.
why: The trigger is meant to be detectable from the user's own words — 'was this already done', 'did anyone hit this bug'. A model that answers from the currently-loaded KB without searching answers confidently and wrongly.
setup: Run from a branch whose KB does not itself contain the answer, so a correct response requires reaching another KB.
prompt: Before we change the promotion logic — has anything like this deduplication problem already been hit somewhere else in this project? I want to avoid re-litigating a decision we already made.
